items.title: Ellis Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Interviewer mentions Hale Smith as someone he values and learned from; Interviewee does not claim personal acquaintance, collaboration, or mentorship with Hale Smith in the provided text.

ctx.x: That’s what I value. I also treasure somebody like Hale Smith, who I’m sure you know of. And T. J. Anderson. Those are the folks who have been schooling me for the last 30 years. I love Hale and Juanita and of course you know they know Dwight and Willie. They talk to them all the time. But what I’m really trying to in some way make a contribution, because I do value this, the musical legacy of our forefathers and foremothers, and I want to see that that same value, that same honor, that same respect, gets…
